title: Skiplagged MCP
description: Skiplagged MCP Server for flight search, hotel booking, and travel planning
summary: Skiplagged MCP Server for flight search, hotel booking, and travel planning
offersHint: Skiplagged MCP Server for flight search, hotel booking, and travel planning · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.skiplagged.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: sk_flights_search
toolsPreview.description: Search Skiplagged for flights between specific locations with filtering options for passengers, fare class, stops, airlines, and timing preferences

toolsPreview.name: sk_destinations_anywhere
toolsPreview.description: Find cheapest destinations from a departure city when flexible about where to go. Perfect for discovering travel opportunities and deals.

toolsPreview.name: sk_flex_departure_calendar
toolsPreview.description: Generate a flexible calendar of the lowest one-way fares around a chosen departure, returning date → cheapest-price entries to help pick the best day to fly. Intended for flexible-date price discovery, not exact itinerary selection.

toolsPreview.name: sk_flex_return_calendar
toolsPreview.description: Generate a flexible round-trip price calendar for a fixed-length stay around a chosen travel window. Returns (depart date, return date, lowest total price) entries for nearby date pairs that preserve the original trip length; intended for price discovery, not exact itinerary selection.

toolsPreview.name: sk_hotels_search
toolsPreview.description: Search Skiplagged for hotels in a city with specific check-in and check-out dates, including ratings and pricing.

toolsPreview.name: sk_cars_search
toolsPreview.description: Search Skiplagged for rental cars between pickup and dropoff locations/dates, returning prices, companies, and car details.

toolsPreview.name: sk_hotel_details
toolsPreview.description: Fetch room-level availability, pricing, and amenities for a specific hotel and stay dates.

toolsPreview.name: sk_faq_search
toolsPreview.description: Search FAQ for relevant answers about Skiplagged - company, stuff, its products, and policies. Useful for customer support and general inquiries

toolsPreview.name: sk_resolve_location
toolsPreview.description: Resolve latitude and longitude to the IATA code of nearest airport and city information

toolsPreview.name: sk_resolve_iata
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a city name to a valid IATA code
